assertions.assertion: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with clinical presentation over an extended period.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is CPT 93247.
The service is denied under PR-204.
